name: Roma Florence Walker (Hathaway)
sources: Ancestry.com, 1950 United States Federal Census (Richland, Benton County, Washington; ED 3-26, page 33)
Ancestry.com, Washington, U.S., Marriage Records, 1854-2013 (Roma Florence Walker and Paul Carleton Hathaway, Franklin County, 1962)
Ancestry.com, public member tree of Ed Simons (tree 189265374)
Ed Simons, family account of Marrion's adoption, relayed by Brendan Adams, 25 Sep 2026
notes: Born 5 Sep 1943 (Washington marriage records); Ed Simons's tree gives the place as Bend, Oregon. Aged 6 in the 1950 census at Richland; in the 1961 Kennewick High School yearbook; married Paul Carleton Hathaway in Franklin County in May 1962. Ed Simons's tree also names a husband Theodore Walters.
Named Roma Florence for her mother's birth mother, Roma Eloise Abernathy, and adoptive mother, Florence (Goodenough) Hinds (family account, 2026).
